title: System Control Board: everything starts closed
why: Jason, 2026-11-18, with a screenshot of the Holding now and Query timings panels open across the top: 'these need to be collapsed on load'. Then, asked whether held systems and rows should start closed too: 'Close all on load'. Both panels are now folds, closed on load, each with a one-line summary: 'Holding now 15: W0 Indexer, W1 Listings and 13 more', 'Query timings: all 4 within their limits' (or how many are over). Every system and process row starts closed as well; each system's header still counts its held, working and off. A link in Holding now opens that process and its system. The 30-second refresh keeps whatever you opened (it already did for systems and rows; now the panels too). Built on Sync 17:09 UTC, after #924 (control-board-check-parts-2) went live. Rendered at 390px and 1280px: nothing open on load, no sideways scroll, the panel opens on tap, and a Holding now link opens W0 and its system. No tables or migrations. FAQ: one line.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
